headline: Safety Score ships seven releases to 10.41, and partial-chain supply is no longer published as complete.
fieldNotes: Much of the week's work withheld values that only looked observed. A DefiLlama price shared by five or more list assets, or a quote exactly at the peg, now counts as a default, and a lone uncorroborated print no longer opens a backfilled depeg episode. Supply totals that miss chains carry a partial label. At release, Safety Score 10.37 classified 915 of 2,877 open questions as documentation gaps that cannot move a score.

summary.label: Safety Score 10.41
summary.description: Seven releases, 10.35 to 10.41. 10.37 separates documentation gaps that cannot move a score, /coverage/ publishes open-evidence counts, and a rail withheld by a pipeline gap no longer yields a no-viable-exit verdict.

summary.label: Pricing 6.65
summary.description: Eight releases. DefiLlama fill prices and uncorroborated quotes exactly at the peg are rejected, the RedStone lane is retired after its gateways shut, and Kraken and Coinbase books and Curve routes add second sources.

summary.label: Depeg detection 6.42
summary.description: Four releases. A lone uncorroborated print no longer opens a backfilled episode, each DDR family shows one public incident, and disputed rows leave counts. DDR 5.1 stops reading unavailable supply as no break.

summary.label: Partial-chain supply
summary.description: Supply history, datasets and the homepage keep each reading's partial-chain evidence, so a total missing chains is never shown as complete; 24h, 7d and market-cap changes are withheld on partial coverage.

summary.label: Mint/burn admission gate
summary.description: Mint/burn 6.31 to 6.33: new issuance legs publish only once their scan history covers the longest window, a stalled leg is quarantined alone, and USDT issuance on Tron is tracked through the gate.

summary.label: Catalog lifecycle
summary.description: Thirteen coins froze, including USDN after Noble's wind-down and dTRINITY's dUSD and sdUSD. swanUSD joined the active catalog and bUSD0 returned (388 active, from 395). EURXT, AEDZ, ZLUSD and DDSC joined /upcoming/.

summary.label: Compliance and crawlable evidence
summary.description: 101 MiCA and GENIUS rows were backfilled for 96 active coins, and the OCC's final GENIUS rule is recorded. Profiles and chain hubs list contract addresses in static HTML, and public datasets become citable.

summary.label: Fail-closed sweep
summary.description: A verified sweep fixed 142 fail-closed findings in Worker, cron, API, Telegram and shared code. Unavailable chain totals and portfolio exposure no longer show $0, and pages keep their data through refresh errors.
